title: Implement multi-word index matching
description: Model matching should match each word against the index independently. If user types "DELL XXXXX", it should match entries where the model contains either "DELL" or "XXXXX". Users should be guided to enter only one word per dimension for best results.

title: Lazy-load indexes in web interface
description:
When searching via the web interface, only load indexes as required to minimize initial page load time.

Options:
1. Load on-demand: When user clicks a search tab (vendors, products, codes, sizes), show loading spinner while fetching that index
2. Progressive background loading: Load indexes in priority order after initial page load (e.g., products first since most common, then vendors, then sizes, then codes)

Index sizes for reference:
- vendors.idx: 254 KB
- products.idx: 802 KB  
- codes.idx: 1.2 MB
- sizes.idx: 228 KB

Implementation considerations:
- Use fetch() with appropriate caching headers
- Consider IndexedDB for client-side caching of loaded indexes
- Show loading state in UI when index not yet available
- Possibly prefetch on hover over tab

title: Switch from DuckDB to DuckLake for intermediate storage
description: Replace DuckDB with DuckLake (MotherDuck's open table format) for the intermediate storage format. DuckLake uses Parquet files which should be faster to build and easier to publish/distribute.
